info.name: TollBit Auth Tokens Search Content API

params.name: size
params.description: Number of results to return. Maximum value is 20.

params.name: next-token
params.description: Token for pagination. If provided, continues from the encoded page. If not provided, returns first page.

params.name: properties
params.description: Comma-separated list of domains (max 20) to boost in search results. When provided, generates a custom goggle string.

params.name: allowedOnly
params.description:
When true, restrict search to properties the calling org is allowed to access.
Intersects with `properties` when both are provided.
Currently mirrors `readyToLicense`; will be expanded to broader allowlist semantics later.

params.name: readyToLicense
params.description: When true, restrict search to properties ready to license (rates-enabled / content-catalog path). Intersects with `properties` when both are provided. Currently equivalent to `allowedOnly`.
